description: This file provides HTTP utility functions wrapping fetch API calls with error handling, including methods for GET, POST, PATCH, PUT, and DELETE, and manages authentication tokens and fingerprinting.

methods.name: httpCall
methods.description: Performs an HTTP request with error handling, including token management and fingerprinting.

methods.name: httpPost
methods.description: Sends a POST request with JSON body.

methods.name: httpGet
methods.description: Sends a GET request with optional query parameters.

methods.name: httpPatch
methods.description: Sends a PATCH request with JSON body.

methods.name: httpPut
methods.description: Sends a PUT request with JSON body.
